items.performers: Hilary Summers, contralto; Ensemble intercontemporain; Pierre Boulez
items.label: Deutsche Grammophon
items.note: René Char’s poems are sung by a contralto, with alto flute, guitar and viola beside tuned percussion. Hilary Summers sings without display in the composer’s Grammy-winning recording with Ensemble intercontemporain, which plays with restraint and places the silences as carefully as the notes. The spare movement for voice and flute sits among the instrumental pieces.

links.title: Deutsche Grammophon — Le Marteau sans maître / Boulez

items.label: Deutsche Grammophon
items.note: Two pianos, harp, cimbalom and tuned percussion alternate with a chamber ensemble through live electronics. Boulez conducts Ensemble intercontemporain, the players who developed the piece with him. The recording is in stereo, which cannot place the audience inside the circle for the soloists’ first electronically expanded entrance. The coupling is Dialogue de l’ombre double, in which Alain Damiens’s live clarinet plays against its recorded double.

items.work: Pli selon pli — Portrait de Mallarmé
items.performers: Christine Schäfer, soprano; Ensemble intercontemporain; Pierre Boulez
items.label: Deutsche Grammophon
items.note: A portrait of Mallarmé for soprano and orchestra, made from settings of his poems. Schäfer sings the definitive 1989 version, with Boulez conducting the Ensemble intercontemporain.
